rationale: All four lenses and standards ran; 11 blocking findings, including unmet AC4, AC7, AC9/AC11 and AC15 (lockfile not regenerated, ocr_model factory never wired). Graph event-loop reuse could not be confirmed live, so it is capped at major and confidence is low. No deferred items; 10 lens claims dismissed as doc, test-style or non-blocking noise.

standards_review.notes: documented format is EPMCDME-####: Description; commit 'epmcdme-15199: add planning artifacts' in the review range uses a lowercase ticket and lowercase description. The other 17 subjects conform.

guide prefers 'X | None' over typing.Optional in new code; Optional is used in enrichment.py, errors.py, retry.py and tools.py of the new codemie_tools/ms_exchange package. Also typing.Tuple/Union imported in enrichment.py. License headers present in all ms_exchange .py files.
grep of ms_exchange sources and settings_tester.py found no credential logging, lossy decode before parsing, or disabled TLS verification. Deep review of auth flows not performed.

findings.title: Lockfile not regenerated for new dependencies
findings.problem: pyproject.toml adds msgraph-sdk, exchangelib and requests-ntlm, but poetry.lock contains none of them. kiota_abstractions is imported directly by graph_client.py but not declared. requests-ntlm is not imported anywhere in the diff.
findings.impact: AC15 unmet: reproducible installs and container builds do not include the packages, so the toolkit fails at import.
findings.recommendation: Run poetry lock, commit poetry.lock, declare kiota_abstractions if imported directly, and drop requests-ntlm if unused.

findings.title: Client construction escapes typed error mapping
findings.problem: get_client instantiates GraphExchangeClient and EwsExchangeClient, whose constructors call build_graph_client and build_ews_client outside _call. Config or credential constructor exceptions therefore escape tool execute as raw provider exceptions, not a sanitised ExchangeError or InternalError.
findings.impact: AC9 and AC11 require typed sanitised errors on direct execute; provider text (URLs, accounts) can leak to the tool caller.
findings.recommendation: Wrap construction in try/except Exception and raise map_*_exception(exc) or InternalError with 'from None'.

findings.title: Legacy typing.Optional/Tuple/Union in new modules
findings.problem: code-quality.md prefers 'X | None' and modern generics and requires 'from __future__ import annotations'. New modules use Optional (enrichment.py, errors.py, retry.py, tools.py) and enrichment.py imports Tuple and Union. Standards locations: enrichment.py:24,48,64,72; errors.py:25,142,151,155; retry.py:19,32,45; tools.py:20,93,110,111,113,124.
findings.impact: Documented blocking code-quality standard is broken in new code.
findings.recommendation: Replace Optional[X] with 'X | None', use builtin generics, and drop unused typing imports.

findings.title: EWS attachment content fetched outside retry wrapper
findings.problem: FileAttachment.content is lazy and triggers a network fetch. It is accessed outside self._call, so the fetch is neither retried nor error-mapped.
findings.impact: Attachment fetch errors surface unmapped, and provider text can leak. Reachability was not confirmed against a live exchangelib.

findings.title: EWS timeout set on process-global class attribute
findings.problem: build_ews_client assigns BaseProtocol.TIMEOUT, a process-wide exchangelib class attribute. ews_url is only checked as non-blank, with no scheme or host validation.
findings.impact: Every exchangelib user in the process is affected and tenants race on the value. An http:// URL sends NTLM credentials in cleartext, and internal or metadata hosts are reachable (SSRF) through the settings tester.
findings.recommendation: Set the timeout per connection via a custom HTTP adapter, and require an https scheme and a valid host in ews_url.

findings.title: Graph list_folders and list_attachments truncate at first page
findings.problem: mail_folders.get() is called with no top and no odata_next_link paging, and child folders are not walked. list_attachments also does not page. resp.value is dereferenced outside _call, so a None response raises an unmapped AttributeError.
findings.impact: Graph returns about 10 folders per page, so folders are silently dropped. EWS walks the full tree, so the transports diverge.
findings.recommendation: Use top=250, follow odata_next_link until exhausted, guard resp is None, and walk child folders to match EWS.

findings.title: Graph read omits text-body Prefer header
findings.problem: _folder_messages, used by read and list_messages, sends no Prefer: outlook.body-content-type="text" header. Only retrieve_by_id and enrich_body send it (the header is added at line 106), and no test asserts it for read.
findings.impact: AC4 is a required criterion and is only partially met, so Graph read returns HTML bodies where text was specified.
findings.recommendation: Add the Prefer header to the _folder_messages request configuration and add a test asserting it.

findings.title: Graph folder argument accepts only ids and well-known names
findings.problem: The folder string is passed straight to by_mail_folder_id(folder). The tool documents 'folder name or well-known name', and EWS resolves display names. An empty folder builds a malformed path.
findings.impact: A display name such as 'Sent Items' returns FolderNotFound on Graph but works on EWS, so behaviour diverges between transports.
findings.recommendation: Resolve display names through list_folders to an id when the value is not a well-known alias, and reject empty or whitespace folder values.

findings.title: Graph async client reused across fresh event loops
findings.problem: One GraphServiceClient is built per client instance, but each _call runs asyncio.run on a new loop, including on retries. Only a mocked client is tested. Reachability was not confirmed (uncertain, capped at major).
findings.impact: Loop-bound httpx and credential resources may fail with 'Event loop is closed' on a second call or retry.
findings.recommendation: Build the GraphServiceClient inside the coroutine for each call, or keep a persistent loop thread; add a test using a real client across two calls.

findings.title: ocr_model_factory never injected, ocr_model ignored
findings.problem: EnrichBodyTool._resolve_ocr needs an ocr_model_factory that no code in src supplies; toolkit_service.py only injects chat_model. Without the factory, ocr_model is silently ignored and assistants get chat_model OCR instead. Workflow nodes without chat_model skip every image. Tests pass a MagicMock factory directly.
findings.impact: AC7 (OCR model resolution, three cases) is unmet: the advertised ocr_model argument does nothing in production.
findings.recommendation: Wire a factory using get_llm_by_credentials at tool construction, or build the model inside the tool. Add a host-boundary test in toolkit_service.

findings.title: Commit subject violates EPMCDME-#### format
findings.problem: Commit 'epmcdme-15199: add planning artifacts' in the review range uses a lowercase ticket and lowercase description. git-workflow.md requires 'EPMCDME-####: Description'.
findings.impact: commit-format is a documented blocking standard.
findings.recommendation: Reword the commit to 'EPMCDME-15199: Add planning artifacts'.
